narrative_goal: Show that without global action, average global temperature is projected to rise to 3°C above the 1951-1980 baseline by 2100, far beyond the 1°C warming already experienced.
intent_en: Trace the projected change in average global temperature relative to the 1951-1980 baseline from 1900 through 2100 and compare the end-of-century level with the warming already experienced by 2020.
